summary: The registrant, Carlyle Credit Income Fund, filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 9.01 to furnish a summary press release and earnings presentation announcing its second quarter 2026 financial results and the declaration of monthly common and preferred dividends. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings report, not a special situation.
